answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the hollow of free entry disappears, the mirror of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the zenith case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm.
